Learners who currently need support with L2 (Blending) as either not yet demonstrated or developing: LS-4C92D4, LS-208055, LS-946620, LS-B85FDE, LS-A25249, LS-C18A90, LS-7308AA, and LS-85427B.

General guidance (not from your class data):

**15-Minute CVC Blending Activity**
* **Warm-up (3 mins):** Flash individual sound cards (e.g., /s/, /a/, /t/, /p/) for rapid recall.
* **Main Activity (8 mins):** 
  * Place three letter cards on a table to form a CVC word (e.g., *c-a-t*).
  * Have learners say each sound while tapping under the letter, then slide a finger across to blend them into the full word.
  * Swap cards to build new words (e.g., *p-i-n*, *m-a-p*).
* **Wrap-up (4 mins):** Oral blending game—say individual sounds slowly (e.g., /b/-/u/-/s/) and have learners call out the blended word.
